measurements.notes: Hanover County Board of Supervisors REJECTED the 430-acre Mountain Road Technology Park 4-3 in May 2026 after months of organized resident opposition on water use, environment, traffic and noise. A split denial against mobilized residents is the strongest negative signal this factor captures.

Required both a conditional use permit and rezoning; both were denied. The entitlement pathway is demonstrably contested in this specific corridor, as distinct from the same county's Beaverdam district where the same developer was approved unanimously.

US domestic deployment. Advanced accelerators may be installed and operated at a US site without export licensing; the controls govern export and re-export, not domestic use. Rule set checked 2026-09-03 — this is the fastest-moving input in the framework and must be re-verified per analysis.

gates.name: Credible power path to target load
gates.reason: Substation available capacity is unknown — the most common cause of late-stage project failure. Verify with the utility before committing capital.
gates.remediation_hint: Evaluate behind-the-meter generation, or shift target year, or reduce target load.

gates.name: Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture
gates.reason: Water availability and rights both unmeasured.
gates.remediation_hint: Switch to air-cooled or closed-loop (costs 10-30% more power), or secure reclaimed water.

gates.name: Flood exclusion
gates.reason: Outside the 500-year floodplain (modeled return period 1000 yr).
gates.remediation_hint: Site the pad outside the mapped zone, or commission a local flood study — global datasets are coarse.

gates.name: Sufficient contiguous developable land
gates.remediation_hint: Expand the AOI, consider adjacent parcel assembly, or re-profile to a smaller build.

gates.name: Entitlement path exists
gates.reason: Requires discretionary rezoning (rezoning_contested) — this converts an engineering problem into a political one.
gates.remediation_hint: Pre-application meeting with planning staff; budget 9-24 months and community engagement.

gates.name: Protected area exclusion
gates.remediation_hint: Reconfigure the site boundary to avoid overlap entirely — mitigation pathways are slow and uncertain.

gates.name: No active data center moratorium
gates.reason: Organized local opposition is present and has defeated or delayed comparable applications.
gates.remediation_hint: Verify moratorium scope and expiry; some exempt by-right industrial zones or cap by megawatt.

gates.name: Intended compute is legally deployable
gates.remediation_hint: Re-profile to domestically-available accelerators, or evaluate license pathway with counsel.

hyperscale_training.headline: Not yet — and the reason is missing evidence, not a bad site. 7 knockout checks cannot be evaluated at all because the factor each one reads is unmeasured; 16 unmeasured factors could each move the verdict across a threshold on its own; only 27% of the decision weight is measured. Profitability in particular is unanswerable here: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return. The verification queue is ordered by how much of the decision each answer settles.
hyperscale_training.profitability_basis: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return.

blockers.title: Baseline water stress is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Will-serve letter or withdrawal permit precedent

blockers.title: Water rights and withdrawal permitting is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 7 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Permit precedent for comparable industrial withdrawal in the same basin

blockers.title: Substation available capacity is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Load-serving study or written statement of available capacity at the named substation, for the named load, in the named year.

blockers.title: Interconnection queue time to energization is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Queue position and cluster study schedule for a comparable request
blockers.owner: ISO/RTO interconnection queue, then the utility

blockers.title: Contiguous developable area is unmeasured, and Sufficient contiguous developable land depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 4 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: ALTA survey or local equivalent showing contiguous developable acreage

blockers.title: Coastal flood and sea level rise exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 3 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Site-specific study; global rasters are screening-grade only

blockers.title: Protected area and habitat overlap is unmeasured, and Protected area exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 3 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Zoning determination letter and title/survey

blockers.title: Modeled 10-year TCO is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, straddling the boundary between 'viable' and 'strong-candidate' — the verdict is not determined by the evidence on hand.
blockers.resolve: 10-year TCO model built on the confirmed tariff, land price and scope

blockers.title: Physical water supply availability is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, straddling the boundary between 'viable' and 'strong-candidate' — the verdict is not determined by the evidence on hand.
blockers.resolve: Will-serve letter or withdrawal permit precedent

blockers.title: Permitting timeline is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, straddling the boundary between 'viable' and 'strong-candidate' — the verdict is not determined by the evidence on hand.
blockers.resolve: Median approval duration for comparable applications, from the record

blockers.title: Construction labor availability is unmeasured
blockers.why: Resolving this moves the score by up to 7 points, straddling the boundary between 'viable' and 'strong-candidate' — the verdict is not determined by the evidence on hand.
